profile.name: Alex Weeks
profile.title: IT Operations & Technology Leader
profile.tagline: Connecting business strategy and technology operations to deliver resilient, cost-effective IT.
profile.summary: IT operations and technology leader with experience overseeing infrastructure, technical teams, vendor relationships, financial planning, and IT governance. Delivered measurable results, including a 50% reduction in cloud costs and automation that eliminated manual workloads equivalent to two full-time employees. Combines hands-on technical expertise with operational accountability, resource management, and cross-functional execution across business and mission-critical environments.
profile.aboutSubtitle: Leading people, technology, and operations with discipline and accountability.

experience.summary: Lead infrastructure operations, business automation, vendor management, and technology governance for a 39-person organization, driving cost reduction, operational efficiency, and service reliability.
highlights: Reduced cloud expenditures by 50% through infrastructure optimization and resource management while maintaining required business capabilities and service levels.
Designed and implemented 35 business process automations, eliminating manual effort equivalent to two full-time employees and increasing capacity for higher-value work.
Manage a portfolio of 28 technology vendors with approximately $750K in annual spend, overseeing vendor relationships, service delivery, and technology procurement.
Prepare the organization's full $2.5M annual IT budget for management approval, coordinating technology spending plans, vendor costs, improvement projects, and operational requirements.
Established IT governance from the ground up, authoring the organization's IT policies, standards, and procedures to formalize security practices, operational controls, and technology management.

experience.summary: Led hardware configuration, inventory control, and shipping operations while directly supervising six employees. Held responsibility for team performance, staffing, employee development, and operational results across high-volume enterprise IT logistics.
highlights: Supervised and managed six direct reports, overseeing hiring, time-off approvals, performance reviews, salary increases, and employee discipline while maintaining team performance and operational continuity.

Led enterprise hardware configuration operations supporting 300 clients and more than 100,000 computer configurations across 550 system images, maintaining configuration standards and coordinating execution across diverse client environments.
Managed approximately $2 million in client hardware inventory, overseeing asset tracking, inventory accuracy, purchasing thresholds, and hardware availability.

experience.summary: Provided onsite technical support across client environments, troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues while coordinating technical resources to resolve incidents and support project delivery.
highlights: Diagnosed and resolved onsite hardware, software, and network issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting and end-user support across client environments.

Coordinated onsite project activities, documented technical findings, and communicated customer issues and project status to technical teams and project leadership. Assisted less experienced technicians with troubleshooting and customer communication.

experience.summary: Delivered enterprise help desk support, resolving application, access, and infrastructure-related issues while meeting service quality and customer satisfaction expectations.
highlights: Earned the Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Award for achieving the third-highest customer satisfaction score across the entire help desk of over 100 employees.
Resolved enterprise IT issues involving Active Directory, Exchange, DNS, software applications, and user access while meeting established service and performance targets.

Created and maintained knowledge base articles to improve troubleshooting consistency and escalated enterprise-wide or production-impacting incidents to Corporate Operations and Major Incident Management teams.

roles.summary: Lead secure communications, network infrastructure, and technical operations supporting mission-critical logistics and command functions across expeditionary, mobile, and fixed environments.
highlights: Accountable for approximately $3 million in communications and network assets across dispersed operational sites, maintaining operational readiness, configuration compliance, and zero loss of government property.

Designed and sustained secure network architectures connecting 10 geographically dispersed operational sites and operated eight satellite communications platforms to maintain resilient connectivity and secure data exchange.
Led a 16-person technical support organization, including three direct reports and 13 indirect personnel, delivering service desk support for logistics information systems and mission-critical users.
Maintained cybersecurity and configuration compliance across approximately 100 mission systems through software patching, vulnerability remediation, and implementation of security controls.

roles.summary: Led an eight-person communications security function through two subordinate leaders, overseeing personnel, secure communications support, and operational accountability.
highlights: Led an eight-person organization, directly supervising two subordinate NCOs who each led three additional personnel, coordinating team execution, accountability, and personnel development.
Oversaw communications security operations, emphasizing the proper safeguarding, control, and accountability of COMSEC equipment and materials in accordance with applicable Army requirements.

roles.summary: Installed, operated, and maintained multi-user information systems while supporting tactical communications, systems integration, technical training, and operational documentation.
